title: Campaigns
description: Campaigns from all advertisers that your account can access.
searchHint: An exact number (optionally with #) or part of the name. Special characters are treated as text.
statusHint: Choose a suggestion or enter the exact server value. Leave blank for all statuses, including older ones.
countUnknown: The total is unavailable. The next page is checked separately; use Previous and Next.
profilesUnavailable: Some advertiser profiles are unavailable. User IDs are shown instead of company names; the campaign list remains available.
tariffsUnavailable: Some plan names are unavailable. Their plan IDs are shown instead.
scope: Time zone: Asia/Almaty. Amounts in KZT. Only records permitted by the server are shown; complete administrative access requires a permissions check.

errors.denied: The server denied campaign reads. Administrative access to the ads source is required.
errors.missing: The campaign source or required API fields are unavailable. The server contract needs to be checked.
errors.invalid: The server returned an invalid or incomplete page. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: Could not get a server response. Check your connection and try again.

validation.page: Invalid page number in the URL. Clear the filters to return to the first page.
validation.filters: Invalid filter parameters. Use up to 256 characters without control characters or duplicate parameters.

empty.title: No campaigns found
empty.body: The server returned no accessible campaigns. An empty response may also result from access restrictions.

noMatches.title: No matches
noMatches.body: Change the number, name or status, or clear the filters.

pageEmpty.title: No campaigns on this page
pageEmpty.body: Return to the previous or first page.

detailPending: Full campaign details will be connected separately. The campaign list is available now.
invalidId: Invalid campaign UUID. Return to the list and select a campaign.
